impact_summary.value: 공정 밸리데이션, 분석법 검증, 안정성 시험 및 제조용수 관리의 중대한 CGMP 일탈로 API가 오염된 것으로 간주되며, 미국 수입 보류와 신규 신청·보완 승인 보류 또는 입국 거부로 이어질 수 있습니다.

evidence.quote: Because your methods, facilities, or controls for manufacturing, processing, packing, or holding of drugs as described in your response to our 704(a)(4) request do not conform to CGMP, your APIs are adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the FD&C Act

FDA placed all drugs and drug products offered from your firm for import into the United States on Import Alert 66-40 on January 30, 2026. Correct any deviations promptly. FDA may withhold approval of new applications or supplements listing your firm as a drug manufacturer until any deviations are completely addressed and we confirm your compliance with CGMP.

affected_work.value: 해당 업체의 미국 수출용 API 제조·시험·안정성 관리와 제조용수 관리가 대상입니다. 특히 무균 의약품 추가 가공 및 약국 조제에 사용되는 API와 미국에 유통된 API가 언급됩니다.

evidence.quote: These APIs are for use in further processing to produce sterile drug products and for pharmaceutical compounding operations.
your firm failed to perform test method validation or verification for each test method used for drugs distributed to the United States.

recommendation.value: 기관은 공정 밸리데이션 프로그램과 적격성 평가 자료, 유통된 API의 위험 평가 및 후속 조치, 시험실 독립 평가와 개선 계획, 안정성 프로그램 평가·CAPA 계획, 제조용수 모니터링 절차와 시험 자료를 제출하고, 확인된 일탈을 신속히 시정하도록 요구합니다.

evidence.quote: In response to this letter, provide: A detailed summary of your validation program for ensuring a state of control throughout the product lifecycle, along with associated procedures.

A comprehensive, independent assessment of your laboratory practices, procedures, methods, equipment, documentation, and analyst competencies. Based on this review, provide a detailed plan to remediate and evaluate the effectiveness of your laboratory system.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any deviations and to prevent their recurrence.
